content.name: Remove One Element
content.description:
给出一个长度为 $n$ 的序列。

你可以选择性地删除掉该序列中的一个元素，这样，最后的序列长度为 $n-1$ 或 $n$。

你需要求出，在选择性的删除操作后，该序列的最长上升子区间的长度
content.formatI:
第一行一个整数 $n$，表示序列的长度。

第二行 $n$ 个整数，表示题目中描述的序列 $a_1,a_2, \cdots ,a_n$。
content.formatO: 一行一个整数，表示在选择性的删除操作后，该序列的最长上升子区间的长度。
content.hint:
$2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$，$1 \le a_i \le 10^9$。

感谢 @_Wolverine 提供的翻译

en.name: Remove One Element
en.description:
You are given an array $ a $ consisting of $ n $ integers.

You can remove at most one element from this array. Thus, the final length of the array is $ n-1 $ or $ n $ .

Your task is to calculate the maximum possible length of the strictly increasing contiguous subarray of the remaining array.

Recall that the contiguous subarray $ a $ with indices from $ l $ to $ r $ is $ a[l \dots r] = a_l, a_{l + 1}, \dots, a_r $ . The subarray $ a[l \dots r] $ is called strictly increasing if $ a_l < a_{l+1} < \dots < a_r $ .
en.formatI:
The first line of the input contains one integer $ n $ ( $ 2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5 $ ) — the number of elements in $ a $ .

The second line of the input contains $ n $ integers $ a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n $ ( $ 1 \le a_i \le 10^9 $ ), where $ a_i $ is the $ i $ -th element of $ a $ .
en.formatO: Print one integer — the maximum possible length of the strictly increasing contiguous subarray of the array $ a $ after removing at most one element.
en.hint: In the first example, you can delete $ a_3=5 $ . Then the resulting array will be equal to $ [1, 2, 3, 4] $ and the length of its largest increasing subarray will be equal to $ 4 $ .
